qa_pair.question: In the sanitized healthy workload-identity fixture, what is the exact parent playbook status? Answer with the status token only.
In the sanitized healthy fixture, what is the exact overall target alignment? Answer with the alignment token only.
When permission and credential evidence use different opaque workload references, what exact alignment is assigned to each unmatched target?
When the same workload identity has both unexpected application permission and insufficient ownership findings, what is the severity of the correlated finding?
If application-owner pagination cannot prove completeness, what exact parent playbook status is returned?
If a playbook node halts before the other node runs, what exact alignment is used for the unexecuted node finding?
How many Microsoft Graph write calls are permitted by the signed Workload Identity Readiness playbook? Answer with one integer.
How many delegated scopes are in the playbook contract closure, excluding the common local-session User.Read scope? Answer with one integer.
Which governance profile is required to execute the Workload Identity Readiness playbook? Answer with the exact profile token.
Does the Workload Identity Readiness playbook automatically remediate a finding? Answer true or false.
